introHtml: For coffee lovers who want a generous serving, custom 23 oz coffee mugs offer the perfect capacity. Larger than standard 12 or 16 oz mugs, these mugs keep morning brews hot longer and reduce refill trips. Ideal for office breakrooms, employee gifts, or promotional giveaways, they provide ample space for your logo or message. Choose from ceramic or insulated stainless steel options, with full-color imprint or engraving to match your brand.
